theorem lg_target (n : ℕ) : (n ^ 2 + n) % 2 = 0 := by
  rw [Int.emod_add]
  rw [Int.emod_two_eq_zero_or_one]
  rcases Int.emod_two_eq_zero_or_one n with (h | h)
  · have : n % 2 = 0 := h
    rw [this] at *
    rw [Nat.even_iff] at *
    exact Eq.refl (Nat.even_iff.mpr h)
  · have : n % 2 = 1 := h
    rw [this] at *
    rw [Nat.even_iff] at *
    exact Eq.refl (Nat.even_iff.mpr h)
